title: Scheduled Power Feeder Upgrade & Tree Trimming
affectedArea: Madhapur, Kavuri Hills, Jubilee Hills Road No. 36 & 45
description: TSSPDCL will undertake regular monsoon preparation, overhead 11kV conductor maintenance, and transformer oil filtration. Power supply will be regulated in intervals.

title: Drinking Water Supply Shutdown for Valve Maintenance
description: Due to critical interconnection works on the 1200mm dia MS pumping main under Krishna Phase-III, water supply will remain partially suspended for 12 hours.

title: Hyderabad Metro Extended Night Hours for Tech Conclave
affectedArea: Red Line (Miyapur to LB Nagar) and Blue Line (Raidurg to Nagole)
description: Last metro trains from terminal stations will depart at 11:45 PM instead of 11:00 PM to facilitate attendees returning from the HITEX Tech Summit.

title: CRMP Night Asphalt Milling & Resurfacing Work
affectedArea: JNTU - KPHB Colony - Cyber Towers Flyover Junction
description: Road resurfacing under CRMP Phase-2 will be carried out between 11:00 PM and 05:00 AM. Traffic police will enforce lane diversion. Commuters are advised to exercise caution.

title: Special Commercial Sanitation Drive & Night Sweeping
affectedArea: Charminar Heritage Zone, Madina Market, Laad Bazaar
description: GHMC will deploy secondary tipper compactors and sweeping crews from 10:00 PM onwards to clear festival commercial packaging waste.

title: Underground Optical Fiber Relocation Notice
affectedArea: Gachibowli Outer Ring Road Link & Financial District Phase 1
description: Underground duct relocation along the new underpass construction. Fiber redundancy will prevent disruptions; brief latency spikes may occur for high-bandwidth links.
